mapper.select: select a.id, a.name from sys_permission a right join sys_role_permission b on a.id = b.permission_id where b.role_id = #{roleId} and a.enable_flag = 1 and a.del_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT a.name, a.id, a.perms, a.path FROM `sys_role_permission` b LEFT JOIN sys_permission a ON a.id = b.permission_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role c ON b.role_id = c.role_id WHERE a.enable_flag = 1 and a.del_flag = 0 and c.user_id = #{userId}
